text: Lola Cars became a major stakeholder in PACETEQ, a motorsport data technology and software company, in November 2024.
short: Lola Cars became a major stakeholder in PACETEQ in 2024.

source.name: Professional Motorsport World: Lola Cars becomes a major stakeholder in Paceteq
source.quote: Lola Cars has become a major stakeholder in Paceteq, one of automotive industry’s foremost data technology and software companies.
